title: DeterminismFacet
description: Additive/optional — v0, not frozen. The additive 'determinism' block (NF-012/013/014) recorded inside a capsule env.lock. Records batch-invariance config, tensor-parallel size + reduction order, dtype, and speculative-decoding state so an attested-exact replay can assert bit-identical logits. Absence of this block ⇒ attested:false and today's replay behavior unchanged. 'attested' is computed true only when batch_invariance.enabled and the replay bit-identity assertion has passed; 'degradation_reason' carries the honest non-attested path.

attested.description: Computed field: true only when batch_invariance.enabled and the replay bit-identity assertion passed. Absence of the block ⇒ false. Never true on a non-invariant or facet-less path (SPK-DET-4 honest-degradation invariant).

degradation_reason.description: Populated (non-null) whenever attested is false; null when attested is true. The honest non-attested path (NF-012 §4.2).

batch_invariance.description: Batch-invariant kernel set + digest. batch_invariant_ops (Apache-2.0) is an optional capture-side dependency (NF-012 req 9).

tensor_parallel.description: TP size + reduction-order profile (NF-013). Enables asserting bit-identity when replayed at a different TP size / single node.

speculative_decoding.description: Speculative-decoding flag + draft-model identity + acceptance-trace reference (NF-014).

dtype.description: Compute/storage dtype affecting numerical reproducibility, e.g. 'bfloat16', 'float16', 'float32', 'fp8'.

compute.description: Compute environment (GPU/driver/CUDA/kernel) that bounds bit-identity claims.

logits_digest.description: SHA-256 over the recorded logits the attested-exact replay compares against.

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed.

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash in sha256:<hex> form.

enabled.description: Whether batch-invariant kernels were in use. Required for attested:true (NF-012 §4.1).

reduction_order_profile.description: Reduction-order profile enabling cross-TP bit-identity, e.g. 'tree-fixed-v1'.

enabled.description: Whether speculative decoding was used; when true, replay re-verifies acceptance decisions (NF-014).

draft_model.description: Draft-model identity, or null when speculative decoding is off.

acceptance_trace_ref.description: Relative reference to the recorded draft/verify acceptance trace, or null.

x-novafabric.governed_by: NF-012 (batch-invariant replay attestation), NF-013 (TP-size determinism facet), NF-014 (verified-speculation check)
x-novafabric.adr: ADR-0100 (determinism replay attestation); extends gap-007 env.lock facet + ADR-0086; composes with ADR-0080, ADR-0099, ADR-0024
x-novafabric.stability: v0 — additive, optional, not frozen; gated on SPK-DET-1..5
x-novafabric.attested_rule: attested = batch_invariance.enabled AND replay bit-identity assertion passed; else false with a degradation_reason
